$comment: Contract for the GetMyRoles read (AD-003, AD-089). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_GetMyRoles). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_GetMyRoles
customApi.description: The role codes the caller holds, resolved exactly as the server gate resolves them (AD-089). No permission is enforced: the caller asks only about themselves, and gating it would make sign-in depend on a permission that cannot resolve until sign-in completes. Reads only.

responseProperties.name: RoleCodes
responseProperties.description: JSON array of the role codes the caller holds, less any auto-granted to everyone (AD-090).
